retrievalProfile.description: A weathered, nostalgic composition featuring a central circular marquee sign flanked by a waving flag against a textured sky with bold slab-serif display type.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square-format collage blending patriotic symbols with 1950s roadside architecture, characterized by a muted, sun-bleached color palette and heavy surface distressing including scratches and grain.
coreVisualRelationships: Central circular sign acts as the primary focal point
Waving flag provides a dynamic horizontal backdrop
Vertical poles and sign supports frame the central elements
Top-aligned display text balances the weight of the central sign
coreInvariants: Combination of slab-serif and condensed sans-serif type

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central circular marquee sign at medium scale, flanked by a large waving flag.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular sign with a pointing hand icon.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top display text, moves down to the central sign, then follows the flag's movement across the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Cloudy sky with heavy texture occupies the upper and lower quadrants.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted teal and cream sky tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Desaturated red and blue from the flag.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dark charcoal for sign text and weathered metal.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value in the sky and cream elements; shadows are lifted and warm.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and condensed industrial sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Top text: Thick, blocky slab serifs with square terminals
Sign text: Tall, narrow condensed sans-serif with uniform stroke width
characterSpecificRedesigns: Slight weathering and erosion on the edges of all glyphs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing between a wide, heavy slab serif and a tall, narrow condensed sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Marquee light bulbs in star and arrow shapes

preserve: Slab serif style for top text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif weight and blunt terminals.
Provides the necessary condensed industrial feel for the sign text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vintage-style collage with a central circular weathered metal sign, a star-shaped marquee at the top, and an arrow-shaped marquee at the bottom. Behind the sign, place a large waving American flag and a weathered flagpole against a teal-toned cloudy sky. Apply a heavy texture of scratches, dust, and sun-bleaching.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold slab-serif text in cream at the top of the frame with wide tracking. Inside the circular sign, add condensed sans-serif text in dark charcoal above a simple pointing hand icon.

verificationChecks: Is the top text a heavy slab serif?
Is the sign text condensed and centered?
Does the image have a consistent weathered, scratched texture?
Is the color palette muted and warm-toned?

adjustableVariables: Tracking of the top display text
Scale of the central marquee sign
mustRedesign: Avoid specific brand logos on the sign
Do not use modern high-resolution digital photography look
Ensure the pointing hand is a generic icon, not a specific trademarked graphic

mustAchieve: Tangible metallic texture on the sign
avoid: Pure white or pure black pixels

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic light bulb placement in the marquee shapes
Ensure the flag's folds look natural behind the sign
Verify that the text weathering matches the background distressing
Confirm the sky color is a desaturated teal/blue
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject: Roadside Icon] with [Background: Patriotic Symbol] under a [Texture: Weathered/Scratched] overlay, topped with [Typography: Slab Serif Display].
